notes.title: Demo Update v0.461
notes.content:
-grenade launcher now have frost effect on explosion
-some ui improvement in game and main menu
-new settings 
-improved some of characters animations
-better demo level(shorter but more exciting)
-customization tab now is accessible from menu for preview yet cant use it in game in demo
-talent window is now accessible from menu and you can preview all skills but not available at demo
